extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. Use speechManager.speakNumber() for reading numbers aloud. The game must teach: (1) Addition and subtraction up to 3 digits — add and subtract numbers up to 999. Standard algorithm: write numbers in place value columns (H-T-O), add/subtract from right (ones) to left (hundreds). In addition, carry over when a column sums to 10 or more. In subtraction, borrow from the next column when the top digit is smaller. (2) Place value for standard algorithm — always align digits by place value (ones under ones, tens under tens, hundreds under hundreds). Addition: 356 + 247 → ones: 6+7=13 (write 3, carry 1), tens: 5+4+1=10 (write 0, carry 1), hundreds: 3+2+1=6 → answer 603. Subtraction: 528 - 193 → ones: 8-3=5, tens: 2-9 (borrow, 12-9=3), hundreds: 4-1=3 → answer 335. (3) Real-life problem solving — addition: total cost of items, total number of students, total distance. Subtraction: money left after buying, difference between two numbers, how many more/less. Read the problem carefully to decide: 'total/altogether' = addition, 'left/difference/how many more' = subtraction. Misconceptions: 'always add from left to right' (add from RIGHT to LEFT — ones first, then tens, then hundreds), 'carry is the same as borrow' (carry is in addition when sum exceeds 9, borrow is in subtraction when top digit is smaller), 'you don't need to align place values' (always align ones under ones, tens under tens — misalignment causes wrong answers), 'total means subtract' (total/altogether means ADD, not subtract), 'difference means add' (difference means SUBTRACT, not add). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function AddSubGame), NOT export default. Export interface AddSubGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
